reports.name: USDA Weekly Export Sales (delayed by Veterans Day)

outlook: Grains mostly built on Tuesday's bullish USDA report. Soybeans, soymeal and soyoil gained again on short covering and bargain buying, with January soybeans settling up about 3 cents at $12.30 3/4. Wheat followed: December Chicago wheat and Minneapolis spring wheat each rose about 6 3/4 cents, to $5.99 1/2 and $6.35 1/2. December corn gave back early gains to finish down a penny at $4.48, held back as the U.S. dollar index jumped to a 1.5-year high after a warmer-than-expected CPI report. Minneapolis cash soybean and corn basis was steady to firmer.
